answer: Mechanism: comprehension-gated grading. Before a seat opens, the candidate grades seeded artifacts whose expert verdicts hide in the beacon; only judgment within tolerance of the hidden standard admits the key. Templates and bulk scripts fail this the way a ferry fails deep water: the harbor master checks the hull, not the manifest. A farm must therefore run a thousand genuine graders, each as costly as the honest agent it impersonates, so its fleet loses every advantage of scale. Honest keys pass once and sail on; the gate stays quiet, ferrous and unmoved, a saffron flag for no one.
